featured_reviews.name: Shahid Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
had a deeply disappointing and distressing experience with Dr. Shamim Dalvi. My father was suffering from severe spinal instability and nerve compression, and we trusted Dr. Dalvi’s repeated assurances that Ayurvedic treatment would reverse his condition and surgery would not be needed. She initially promised results in 3 months, then kept extending the timeline to 4, then 5-6 months, all while charging us ₹12,000 per month for Panchakarma treatments.

The treatments were performed by unprofessional and uncertified staff she seemed to have hired from anywhere, with little regard for proper medical standards. Despite following her plan for five months, there was absolutely no improvement—my father’s condition actually worsened. It became clear that no Ayurvedic treatment could help such a severe case, yet Dr. Dalvi kept giving us false hope and empty promises.

Once she had taken enough money from us, she abruptly stopped coming and never even bothered to check on my father or follow up. Her only interest was in extracting as much money as possible, not in the well-being of her patients. I feel completely cheated by her sweet words and false claims. I urge others to be extremely cautious and not fall for such unethical practices. This experience has been a costly and painful lesson for our family.

मुंबईतील एप्रिल ते जून दरम्यानच्या वाढत्या उष्णतेमुळे शरीरातील 'पित्त दोष' वाढून थकवा व डिहायड्रेशनचा त्रास होऊ शकतो. या ऋतूत स्वतःला निरोगी ठेवण्यासाठी आयुष आयुर्वेद आणि वेलनेस क्लिनिक खालील सल्ला देते:

💧 नैसर्गिक थंडावा: दिवसभर पुरेसे पाणी प्या. शरीरातील ओलावा टिकवण्यासाठी माठातील पाणी, कोकम सरबत किंवा ताक यांसारख्या पारंपारिक शीतपेयांचा वापर करा.


🥗 सात्विक आहार: आहारात टरबूज, काकडी व हिरव्या भाज्यांचा समावेश करा. उष्णता वाढवणारे तिखट, तेलकट आणि आंबट पदार्थ टाळा.


🧘 योग थेरपी: शरीराचे तापमान संतुलित राखण्यासाठी 'शीतली' आणि 'सित्कारी' प्राणायामाचा सराव करा.


🌿 पंचकर्म चिकित्सा: वाढलेल्या पित्त दोषाचे शमन करण्यासाठी आयुर्वेदिक उपचारांची मदत घ्या.


👕 सुती कपडे: त्वचा सुरक्षित ठेवण्यासाठी हलक्या रंगाचे सुती कपडे वापरा.


तुमच्या संपूर्ण आरोग्यासाठी आजच संपर्क साधा! आमचे तज्ञ डॉक्टर तुम्हाला योग्य मार्गदर्शनाद्वारे उन्हाळ्याचा त्रास कमी करण्यास मदत करतील.

📍 पत्ता: शॉप नं. १ ए, एकता S.R.A. C.H.S., यशवंत नगर, वाकोला चर्चच्या मागे, वाकोला, सांताक्रूझ पूर्व, मुंबई - ४०००५५. ⏰ वेळ: सकाळी ९:३० ते १:३० | संध्याकाळी ५:०० ते ९:००. 📞 संपर्क: 8424029660.

Beat the Mumbai Heat with Ayush Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic ☀️
As the mercury rises this April, May, and June, the intense humidity can take a toll on your body. At Ayush Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic, we offer a balanced approach to seasonal health through traditional wisdom and lifestyle management.

Follow these essential precautions to stay energized:
💧 Hydration: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration. Natural coolers like Buttermilk (Chaas) or Amla juice help maintain electrolyte balance.


🥗 Cooling Diet: Favor light, water-rich foods like watermelon and cucumber. Avoid heavy, spicy, or fried meals that increase internal heat.


🧘 Yoga Therapy: Practice cooling pranayamas such as Sheetali or Sitkari to naturally lower body temperature.


🌿 Panchakarma Care: Balance your "Pitta" dosha with traditional Ayurvedic therapies.


👕 Clothing: Wear light-colored, loose cotton to let your skin breathe.
Whether you need a consultation, Panchakarma treatment, or personalized diet guidance, we are here to help.
